title: RETRACTION: Pathogenomics Model for Personalized Medicine in Cervical Cancer: Cross‐Talk of Gene Expressions and Pathological Images Related to Oxidative Stress
content:
RETRACTION: J. Li, S. Chen, J. Wu, X. Liu, H. Liu, Y. Liu, and Z. Zhu, “ Pathogenomics Model for Personalized Medicine in Cervical Cancer: Cross-Talk of Gene Expressions and Pathological Images Related to Oxidative Stress,” Environmental Toxicology 39, no. 2 (2024): 751–767, https://doi.org/10.1002/tox.23974.

The above article, published online on 26 September 2023, in Wiley Online Library (http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/), has been retracted by agreement between the journal Editor-in-Chief, Paul Tchounwou; and Wiley Periodicals LLC. Following an investigation by the publisher, the parties have concluded that this article was accepted solely on the basis of a compromised peer review process. Therefore, the article must be retracted.
